FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ClearView Glass Services specializes in residential glass installation and repair, focusing on providing high-quality, efficient service to homeowners and small businesses. Our operations include the measurement, fabrication, and installation of various glass products, such as windows, mirrors, and shower enclosures, primarily for low-rise residential projects. We emphasize safety and compliance, maintaining a documented safety protocol and providing regular training for our team. Our staff is composed mainly of direct-hire employees, which allows for close supervision and quality assurance during all projects. Additionally, we transport glass within a specific local area, implementing strict load-securing practices to ensure safe delivery. We also ensure that all subcontractors hold valid certificates of insurance, aligning with our commitment to operational safety and risk management.
